messages:
lee: deploybot just paused the orbital-api canary (v4.1.0) — ~13% 503s over rolling 5m. auto-hold triggered. :rotating_light:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold applied: orbital-api@4.1.0. Reason: canary error rate exceeded threshold. Remaining phases suspended.

sara: thanks. quick pulse: do we prefer a full rollback or pin + containment?

oncall-sre-bot: pulling canary traces and host logs. early signal: user-space eviction storms on kvcache after yesterday's runtime change.

lee: proposal: pin traffic to 4.0.9 on warm pools (no global rollback), cancel remaining canary slots, cordon affected hosts. That limits churn and keeps stable traffic path.

ops-bot: suggested commands:
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/orbital-api orbital-api=registry/redwood/orbital:4.0.9 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/orbital-api

sara: go ahead and run those. also abort canary retries and mute alerts for the rollout scope.

lee: executed pin+pause, aborted retries, muted alerts. deploybot: please log manual action.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Manual image pin to 4.0.9 recorded by lee. Rollout state: paused. Alerts for rollout muted.

oncall-sre-bot: cordoned 3 hosts in affected pool and scheduled kernel-parameter revert. ETA 25m, then 60m soak.

sara: schedule backfill window: 2026-03-24 02:30-04:30 UTC. owners: sara (releases), lee (deploy), oncall-sre (SRE). update release notes to mark v4.1.0 "on hold - regression investigation" and link INC-2026-2007.

lee: added manual block in Console to prevent accidental promote. will not clear hold until regression tests pass post-soak.

sara: good. post-mortem likely if we require a patch release. sending stakeholder update.

ops-bot: note saved: manual hold by lee, backfill scheduled 2026-03-24 02:30 UTC.

lee: closing thread for coordination; will reopen if plan changes.
